reviews.text:
I’ve been using the APRILSKIN Carrotene IPMP™ Clearing Solution for 18 days, and I’m really happy with how my skin has been responding.
I originally started using it to target uneven skin tone, dark marks and clogged pores. The formula contains IPMP 0.1%, BHA 2%, Zinc 1% and Niacinamide 5%, which makes it a great addition when you’re focusing on clearer, smoother-looking skin.
After 18 days, I’ve noticed that my skin feels smoother and looks more refreshed and even. I also like that the product is lightweight and easy to incorporate into my skincare routine.
It’s still a journey, especially when it comes to dark marks, but I’m happy with the progress so far and I’ll definitely continue using it to see more results over time. 🍊✨
reviews.zh:
我用咗 APRILSKIN Carrotene IPMP™ Clearing Solution 18 日，我對皮膚嘅反應好滿意。
我最初用佢嘅目的係針對膚色不均、暗瘡印同堵塞毛孔。呢款含有 IPMP 0.1%、BHA 2%、鋅 1% 同煙酰胺 5%，令佢成為你想要皮膚更清晰、更平滑嘅時候一個好好嘅選擇。
用咗 18 日之後，我發現皮膚感覺更平滑，睇落更加清新、膚色更均勻。我亦鍾意呢款產品質地輕盈，容易融入我嘅護膚程序。
呢個係一個過程，尤其係暗瘡印方面，但係我對目前嘅進展好滿意，而且我會繼續用，睇吓長遠會有更多效果。🍊✨

reviews.text: 7 days with the Aprilskin Carrotene Clearing Solution, and my skin is already feeling the difference! 🧡✨ I’ve been using it consistently for the past week, and I really love how gentle yet effective it feels on my skin. It leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and comfortable without that dry, tight feeling. I’ve also noticed my skin looking smoother and more radiant. It’s still early days, so I’m excited to continue using it and see how my skin improves with consistent use. Definitely becoming a lovely addition to my skincare routine! 🧡
reviews.zh: 用咗 Aprilskin Carrotene Clearing Solution 7 日，我嘅皮膚已經感受到分別！🧡✨ 我已經連續用咗過去一個星期，我真係好鍾意佢嘅感覺，又溫和又有效。佢令皮膚感覺清潔、清爽、舒服，冇乾燥、緊繃嘅感覺。我亦留意到皮膚睇落更加平滑、更有光澤。而家仲係初段，所以我好期待繼續用，睇吓皮膚持續使用之後會點改善。絕對會成為我護膚程序入面一個好可愛嘅新增產品！🧡

reviews.text: The Aprilskin Carrotene IPMP Clearing Solution is a powerful yet gentle spot treatment that helps calm active breakouts while supporting clearer, healthier-looking skin over time. Its lightweight formula absorbs quickly and works directly on blemishes to reduce redness, soothe irritation, and help speed up the healing process without feeling harsh or overly drying. With ingredients like BHA, PHA, and niacinamide, it also helps unclog pores and improve skin texture, making it great for acne-prone skin. It’s a reliable little treatment that fits easily into any routine and helps keep skin looking more balanced and smooth.
reviews.zh: Aprilskin Carrotene IPMP Clearing Solution 係一款有力但溫和嘅局部護理產品，有助於舒緩活躍嘅痘痘，同時令皮膚睇起嚟更加清晰、健康。佢質地輕盈，吸收快，直接作用喺痘痘上，有助減低紅位、舒緩刺激，並幫助加快癒合過程，而唔會感覺刺激或者過度乾燥。加上 BHA、PHA 同煙酰胺，佢亦有助疏通毛孔、改善膚質，對容易生暗瘡嘅皮膚特別好。呢個係一款可靠嘅小型護理產品，可以輕易融入任何護膚程序，幫助皮膚保持更平衡、更平滑嘅狀態。

reviews.text: What's surprising is that after one application, my pimple is almost completely gone after waking up, although I know this product won't work this way for everyone. As a spot treatment, it's very effective. I reach for it when I get pimples, I'm almost finished with it after using it for six months. It contains a dose of niacinamide that allows for visible skin improvement, also contains BHA and PHA acids that exfoliate, allowing for better absorption of ingredients. It reduces redness and doesn't dry out, but slowly absorbs. I can literally make an ad for them lol
reviews.zh: 令人驚訝嘅係，用咗一次之後，我醒嚟時粒痘幾乎完全消失咗，雖然我知道呢個產品未必對每個人都咁有效。作為局部護理產品，佢好有效。我長暗瘡嗰時都會拎佢出嚟用，用咗六個月，快要用晒。佢含有一定份量嘅煙酰胺，可以令皮膚有明顯改善，亦都含有 BHA 同 PHA 酸，可以去角質，令其他成分吸收得更好。佢減少紅位，唔會令皮膚乾燥，但係吸收得慢。我真係可以幫佢哋做個廣告 lol

reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Aprilskin CARROTENE IPMP Clearing Solution for a few weeks now, and I’m honestly impressed. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy on the skin. It layers well with other skincare products and doesn’t pill.

What I love most is how calming it feels. Whenever I have redness or small breakouts starting, this helps soothe my skin and reduces irritation. My skin looks clearer and more balanced, especially around my T-zone. It doesn’t dry me out like some acne treatments do.

The carrot-based formula gives it a gentle, skin-friendly feel, and it’s great for anyone dealing with acne-prone or sensitive skin. With consistent use, I’ve noticed fewer breakouts and smoother texture.

Definitely a solid product if you’re trying to clear and calm your skin without over-stripping it. Would repurchase!
reviews.zh:
我用咗 Aprilskin CARROTENE IPMP Clearing Solution 幾個星期，真係好有感覺。質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會覺得黏膩或者厚重。同其他護膚品疊用都好好，亦唔會起搓。

最令我鍾意嘅係佢嘅舒緩感。每當我開始有紅位或者細粒暗瘡，佢會幫我舒緩皮膚，減少刺激。我嘅皮膚睇落更加清透、更加平衡，特別係 T 字部位。佢唔會好似某啲暗瘡產品咁令我皮膚乾。

胡蘿蔔配方令佢有一種溫和、對皮膚友好嘅感覺，而且好啱需要處理暗瘡或者敏感皮膚嘅人。持續使用之後，我留意到暗瘡少咗，皮膚紋理都更加平滑。

如果你想清除暗瘡，同時又唔想過度剝走皮膚水分，呢款絕對係一個好產品。會再買！

reviews.text: This is litterally the best spot treatment i ever bought, before this one i had the lion pair acne cream but that doesnt really do anything, this one instead gives results in one night, i put it on in the evening and in the morning my spot was gone, i really recommend it! (pls like im broke)
reviews.zh: 呢個真係我買過最好嘅局部暗瘡產品。喺呢款之前，我用過 lion pair 暗瘡膏，但係冇咩效果；呢款就反而一晚就有效果，我夜晚塗，朝早粒痘就冇咗，真係推薦！（求你撳個 like 啦，我好窮）

reviews.text: This is viral so I gave it a try, although I do not have an acne prone skin, I tend to have acne from time to time and I use this as a spot treatment. The cream has a color orange so make sure that it’s dry before going to bed because it might stain. The formula is light and absorbs quickly and just like any other cream, it doesn’t work like magic, it still takes some time to get it clear but this cream helps in the process.
reviews.zh: 呢款好紅（viral），所以我試吓。雖然我嘅皮膚唔係易生暗瘡嘅類型，但係我間中都會生暗瘡，所以用佢做局部護理。呢款膏霜係橙色嘅，所以瞓覺前要確保乾咗，因為可能會染色。配方輕盈，吸收快；同其他膏霜一樣，佢唔係魔法，都要用啲時間先會清晰，但係呢款膏霜有助呢個過程。

reviews.text: I suddenly got really bad acne around my jawline area. Closed comedonce and cystic pimples. I thought my usual skincare I did in the past would help, but it clearly didn't. My confidence really dropped because of how bad my skin got, and it didn't even get better over time it just got worse. Then I found this product online and I thought let's give it a try. I'm writing this in so much detail so that maybe it will help someone else too. I used this cream on the spots I needed to and in about a week it really made my skin texture better and not so rough looking. My acne also cleared up faster and better. I would really recommend this and I will definitely will keep on buying it. It literally saved my skin and I'm happier with it again. 💗
reviews.zh: 我突然喺下巴位置出現好嚴重嘅暗瘡，有閉口粉刺同囊腫性痘。我以為我以前用嗰啲護膚品會有幫助，但係顯然冇用。皮膚變得咁差，令我好冇信心，而且唔單止冇改善，反而愈嚟愈差。之後我喺網上搵到呢款產品，就諗試吓。我寫得咁詳細，希望可以幫到其他人。我喺需要嘅位置塗呢款面霜，大約一個星期之後，皮膚紋理明顯改善，唔再咁粗糙。我嘅暗瘡亦都更快、更好咁消除。我真心推薦，而且一定會繼續買。佢真係救咗我嘅皮膚，令我再次開心。💗
